gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-mahajani: Rustic and quirky, Amatic SC pushes out toothpaste-like lines with terminals stopping far from the stem. Noto Sans Mahajani stands tall, its lowercase rising against the capitals, and that lift is the pair's best trait.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-malayalam: Amatic SC draws every curve and stem in one steady, toothpaste-squeezed line, casual as pen strokes. Noto Sans Malayalam fills the middle zone with dense, generously opened letters, giving the quirky heading a grounded partner.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-marchen: Ruler-straight yet rustic, Amatic SC keeps a drawn-with-compass feel in every line. Noto Sans Marchen sits beside it with small letters standing almost capital-sized, curves ending in clear daylight, so the page feels crisp.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-medefaidrin: Amatic SC bends its strokes like copper pipe, tubular and casual. Noto Sans Medefaidrin rises high, with no ink pooling where curves turn in, so beside it the rustic heading feels hand-made.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-mende-kikakui: Quirky is the mood Amatic SC sets, with a plain, unshaded line that never swells. Noto Sans Mende Kikakui lets daylight through every curve, so text running on for pages goes down smoothly.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-mono: Amatic SC writes with a marker-tip feel, rustic and quirky, in a single toothpaste line. Noto Sans Mono spaces its letters so they never bump, and that generous room is the pair's sharpest quality.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-mro: Amatic SC has bowls with no thinning at the sides. Noto Sans Mro packs dense, tall-looking words, yet its large entrances into each letter keep text feeling open after that rustic heading.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-multani: Noto Sans Multani offers an e with a wide gap at its terminal and a lofty x-height, modern and open. Amatic SC brings rustic quirk, its round letters sturdy as straight ones.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-nag-mundari: Rustic Amatic SC keeps the arch and stem of its n matching. Noto Sans Nag Mundari handles the sturdier, contemporary reading work, with half-unwrapped curves and lowercase rivaling the capitals.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-nandinagari: Noto Sans Nandinagari reads approachably, with generous openings at every weight, plus short ascenders and large lowercase. Amatic SC adds rustic, quirky handwriting on top, its bowls never swelling.
